products.name: 3-In-1 Foam Plyometric Box - 34kg
products.short_description: Introducing our 3-In-1 Foam Plyometric Box (34kg), the ultimate training tool for explosive and dynamic workouts. Perfect for box jumps, the Masterkraft 3-in-1 Foam Plyo Box combines safety and convenience with a simple flip to either side.
products.description: Introducing our 3-In-1 Foam Plyometric Box (34kg), the ultimate training tool for explosive and dynamic workouts. Perfect for box jumps, the Masterkraft 3-in-1 Foam Plyo Box combines safety and convenience with a simple flip to either side.

meta_data.value: Introducing our 3-In-1 Foam Plyometric Box (34kg), the ultimate training tool for explosive and dynamic workouts. Perfect for box jumps, the Masterkraft 3-in-1 Foam Plyo Box combines safety and convenience with a simple flip to either side.

Each side displays easy to read height measurements. According to the three heights for each side of the plyometric box, athletes can perform box jumps without fear of scraping their shins and still have the security that this counterbalanced box will stay in place. On the inside is wooden reinforcement as well as a large rubber ball filled with iron sand, similar to a slam or dead ball. This stabilising mechanism creates a lower centre of gravity, resulting in a more stable box to jump on and land safely. The jump box is constructed of closed cell high density, impact-absorbing foam with a hard wearing vinyl casing. Choose from 20", 24" or 30" heights by simply pushing from the top and tipping the box over. Push your limits and achieve new heights in your fitness journey.

Assembled Size

  • Width: 610mm
  • Depth: 510mm
  • Height: 750mm
  • Colour: Black
  • Material: Hard wearing vinyl cover
  • Warranty: Internal Frame: 12 months, Cover: 3 monthsmonths
  • Net Weight: 34kg
  • Gross Weight: 35kg

products.name: Abductor & Adductor Machine Elite (Selectorize)
products.short_description: Target and strengthen specific muscle groups in the hips and thighs with our Ab/Back Extension Machine Pro (Selectorize).
products.description: The abductor machine primarily targets the muscles responsible for moving your legs away from the midline of your body, which is known as abduction. It works the outer thigh muscles, including the tensor fasciae latae and the gluteus medius and minimus. The adductor machine, on the other hand, targets the muscles responsible for bringing your legs toward the midline of your body, which is known as adduction. It primarily works the inner thigh muscles, including the adductor longus, adductor magnus, and adductor brevis. With its user-friendly selectorized system, adjustable seat, and padded support, it ensures proper form and comfort during leg curl exercises. Elevate your strength training routine with this durable and efficient machine.

With a heavy duty outer rubber casing the dead ball is made to be dropped, thrown, slammed and take a beating! The Dead Ball - 12kg is the perfect companion to take your training to the next level and achieve exceptional results in strength, power, and overall fitness. Material: PVC & sand. Diameter: 25.4cm.

products.name: Drop In Core Trainer
products.short_description: Get set to sculpt a stronger and more defined core with our Drop In Core Trainer. A simple yet very effective portable training product to help improve and develop core strength and power.
products.description:
The core trainer allows for a multitude of exercises, engaging the full range of core muscles through your mid-section as well as back, arm and leg muscles. This innovative training tool works with existing Olympic weight plates or bumper plates to combine a stable base with an adjustable, dynamic platform, challenging your balance and engaging your core muscles.

The Masterkraft Drop In Core Trainer solves the problem of traditional rotational core trainers by doing away with the heavy base plate reducing the overall weight and size. The vertical post simply 'drops' into the hole in the plate and away you go. This becomes an ideal tool for mobile trainers and those who are simply limited for space.
Get ready to drop in and elevate your core workouts to new heights of effectiveness.

products.description: Take your strength and resistance training to the next level with our Knitted Resistance Bands (Pack of 3).

meta_data.value: Take your strength and resistance training to the next level with our Knitted Resistance Bands (Pack of 3).

Knitted resistance bands are fitness accessories used for strength training, stretching, and various other exercises. With latex rubber woven into the elasticized cotton, these bands are more durable, comfortable, and washable than rubber resistance bands. These bands offer resistance when stretched, providing resistance throughout a range of motion during exercises. Each band in a set provides a different thickness and resistance level indicated by colour, accommodating various fitness levels exercise needs. These bands are versatile and can be used for a wide range of exercises, including squats, lunges, leg lifts, arm exercises, and more. They can target different muscle groups, depending on how they are used. The knitted fabric design provides comfort during use and reduces the risk of the band pinching the skin. Additionally, the knitting technique enhances durability and minimizes the likelihood of the band tearing or snapping during use. Knitted resistance bands are often used in rehabilitation and physical therapy settings to aid in muscle strengthening and rehabilitation exercises for individuals recovering from injuries or surgery.

Whether it’s used by an Olympic weight lifter perfecting his form or a beginner learning the basics, an effective technique bar is one that best simulates the real weight training experience. 

That’s why the REVL Technique/Training Bar is manufactured specifically with the same 28mm outer diameter and correct Olympic knurl marks as our competition bars. At a price tag only a few bucks more than the makeshift PVC pipe or broomstick currently sitting in your gym, the 60-inch Technique/Training Bar is a durable technique training tool that can double as a starter bar for kids and beginners or as a rehab bar for athletes recovering from injury.
